# Paths the triage agent may never auto-merge or auto-fix.
# One extended regex per line, matched against each changed file path.
# A PR touching any of these always goes to a human.

# CI, the triage workflow itself, and its prompts
^\.github/

# Build and runtime environment
^Dockerfile$
^docker-compose\.yml$
^\.dockerignore$
^scripts/

# Dependencies
(^|/)pyproject\.toml$
(^|/)uv\.lock$
(^|/)package(-lock)?\.json$

# Secrets and provider config
^\.env
^backend/app/config\.py$

# Safety-critical: launch limits are the go/no-go call
^backend/app/rules/limits\.py$

# Model client and the no-network test guard
# (the socket block itself is pytest addopts in pyproject.toml, covered above)
^backend/app/llm/
^backend/tests/test_network_blocked\.py$
